descriptionMarkdown:
This ship can go to aquilo at 350km/s and other planets at 550km/s. it requires fusion power, wepons damage 12 and asteroid productivity 7.
it can also bring resources to aquilo at 18k raw iron 7.5k raw copper 18k carbon 3.7k sulfur 5.6k ice and 3.7k calcite per trip which is about 1.5 -2 minutes.
it also has 2659 units of storage.
title: aquilo cargo hauler
